description: The grouped bar chart illustrates the "effect" across nine different language family categories for four distinct model configurations. The horizontal axis contains the categories, which are ordered alphabetically: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "effect," using a linear scale that ranges from below 0 to over 40, with numeric tick marks at intervals of 10 (0, 10, 20, 30, 40) and corresponding horizontal grid lines. Within each category, there is a group of four bars arranged side-by-side. According to the legend, these bars represent different configurations: "mBERT-targ" (light blue), "XLM-targ" (dark blue), "mBERT-permute" (light green), and "XLM-permute" (dark green). Every bar is outlined in black and features a vertical black error bar extending above and below its top edge. The values vary significantly across categories and configurations. The tallest bar is the light blue "mBERT-targ" in the Isolate category, reaching approximately 35. The shortest bars are the light and dark green "mBERT-permute" and "XLM-permute" bars in the Isolate and Uralic categories, which are near 1. In most categories, the light blue and dark blue bars are taller than the light green and dark green bars, with the notable exception of the IE-Indic category, where the green bars (approximately 18 and 16) are taller than the blue bars (approximately 4 and 5).
